**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.5/Spectra.apk)**

### New: custom daily activity
Targets → BMR calculator → **Daily activity** now has a **Custom** option alongside the four presets. Enter it either way:
- **kcal a day:** a fixed number of calories burned moving around on top of BMR, for example your fitness tracker's average active calories on rest days. Stays the same when your weight changes.
- **× BMR:** an activity multiplier, for example 1.45. Maintenance before workouts = BMR × this number. The presets are 1.2, 1.375, 1.55 and 1.725.

Burned, your maintenance and the energy target from your weight goal all use it. Until you enter a number, sedentary is used.
